question_en:
A dealer buys a watch for $\$600$.$ He marks the price so that after giving a discount of $20%$,$ he still makes a profit of $20%$.$
(a) Find the marked price of the watch. (5 marks)
(b) If the watch is sold at a discount of $20%$ instead, find the profit percentage. (4 marks)
question_zh:
商販以 $\$600$ 購入一隻手錶。他設定標價，使得即使在給予 $20%$ 折扣後，仍能獲利 $20%$。
(a) 求該手錶的標價。(5分)
(b) 若改以 $20%$ 的折扣售出，求獲利百分比。(4分)

question_en:
Mr. Lee invests $\$80,000$ in a bank at a rate of $4%$ per annum compounded half-yearly.
(a) Find the amount after 2 years. (5 marks)
(b) Find the interest earned, correct to the nearest dollar. (1 mark)
(c) If the interest was simple interest instead, find the difference in interest earned. (4 marks)
question_zh:
李先生將 $\$80,000$ 存入銀行，年利率為 $4%$，每半年計複利一次。
(a) 求兩年後的本利和。(5分)
(b) 求所得利息（準確至最接近的元）。(1分)
(c) 若利息改以單利息計算，求所得利息的差額。(4分)
solution_steps_en: (a) Rate per period $= $4%$ / 2 = $4%$ = 0.02$.$ Number of periods $= 2 \times 2 = 4$.$

question_en:
A factory's production increases by $10%$ in 2024 and then decreases by $5%$ in 2025.
(a) If the production in 2023 was $50,000$ units, find the production in 2025. (5 marks)
(b) Find the net percentage change in production from 2023 to 2025. (4 marks)
question_zh:
一間工廠的產量在 2024 年增加 $10%$，隨後在 2025 年減少 $5%$。
(a) 若 2023 年的產量為 $50,000$ 件，求 2025 年的產量。(5分)
(b) 求由 2023 年至 2025 年產量的淨百分比變化。(4分)

question_en:
Ms. Wong's annual income is $\$\text{HK$}540,000$\text{HK$}.$ The basic allowance is $\$100%32,000$ and she is entitled to child allowance of $\$100%20,000$\text{HK$}.$ The tax rates are as follows:
- First $\$\text{HK$}50,000$ at $100%$
- Next $\$\text{HK$}50,000$ at $100%$
- Next $\$\text{HK$}50,000$ at $100%$
- Next $\$\text{HK$}50,000$ at $100%$
- Remainder at $100%$
(a) Find her net chargeable income. (3 marks)
(b) Find the salaries tax payable by Ms. Wong. (9 marks)

The cost of a dress is $\$400$.$ It is marked up by $20%$ and then sold at a discount of $20%$.$
(a) Find the marked price. (3 marks)
(b) Find the selling price. (3 marks)
(c) Find the profit percentage. (2 marks)
question_zh:
一件連身裙的成本為 $\$400$。標價加幅為 $20%$，隨後以八折（$20%$ 折扣）售出。
(a) 求標價。(3分)
(b) 求售價。(3分)
(c) 求獲利百分比。(2分)

question_en:
Compare two investment plans for a principal of $\$50,000$ for 3 years:
Plan A: $10%$ per annum simple interest.
Plan B: $10%$ per annum compounded quarterly.
(a) Find the interest earned in Plan A. (3 marks)
(b) Find the interest earned in Plan B (correct to 2 decimal places). (6 marks)
(c) Which plan is better? What is the difference in interest? (2 marks)
question_zh:
比較以下兩項為期 3 年、本金為 $\$50,000$ 的投資計劃：
計劃 A：年利率 $10%$ 的單利息。
計劃 B：年利率 $10%$，每季計複利一次。
(a) 求計劃 A 的利息。(3分)
(b) 求計劃 B 的利息（準確至二位小數）。(6分)
(c) 哪項計劃較佳？利息相差多少？(2分)
solution_steps_en: (b) Rate per quarter $= $10%$ / 4 = $10%$ = 0.0145$.$ Number of periods $= 3 \times 4 = 12$.$
solution_steps_zh: (c) 計劃 B 較佳。相差 $421.95$。

question_en:
The price of a computer includes $5%$ sales tax. If the total price is $\$8400$:
(a) Find the price of the computer before tax. (5 marks)
(b) If the tax rate is increased to $5%$,$ find the new total price. (4 marks)
question_zh:
電腦的價錢包含 $5%$ 的銷售稅。若總價為 $\$8400$：
(a) 求電腦在徵稅前的原價。(5分)
(b) 若稅率增加至 $5%$，求新的總價。(4分)
solution_steps_en: (a) Let the price before tax be $P$.$P \times (1 + $5%$) = 8400$.$

question_en:
A car's value depreciates by $10%$ every year. At the end of 3 years, its value is $\$10%45,800$.$
(a) Find the original price of the car. (6 marks)
(b) Find the total percentage depreciation after 3 years. (4 marks)
question_zh:
一輛汽車的價值每年貶值 $10%$。在 3 年後，其價值為 $\$10%45,800$。
(a) 求該車的原價。(6分)
(b) 求 3 年後的總貶值百分比。(4分)

question_en:
A student spends $100%$ of his pocket money on food and $100%$ of the *remaining* money on books. If he has $\$100%80$ left:
(a) Find the total amount of pocket money he had. (6 marks)
(b) Find the amount spent on food. (3 marks)
question_zh:
一名學生將零用錢的 $100%$ 用於購買食物，再將 *餘下* 金額的 $100%$ 用於購買書籍。若他還剩餘 $\$100%80$：
(a) 求他原本有多少零用錢。(6分)
(b) 求他在食物上的開支。(3分)
solution_steps_zh: (a) 設總零用錢為 $X$。購買食物後餘 $\text{HK$}0.6$X$。購買書籍後餘 $\text{HK$}0.6$X \times 0.75 = 0.45X$。

question_en:
The value of a gold coin in 2020 was $\$20%0,000$.$ In 2021, its value increased by $20%$.$ In 2022, its value increased again by $x%$.$ In 2023, its value decreased by $20%$.$ If the value in 2023 was $\$20%4,580$:
(a) Find the value of $x$.$ (8 marks)
(b) Find the average annual percentage change from 2020 to 2023. (5 marks)
question_zh:
一枚金幣在 2020 年的價值為 $\$20%0,000$。2021 年價值增加 $20%$。2022 年價值再增加 $x%$。2023 年價值減少 $20%$。若 2023 年的價值為 $\$20%4,580$：
(a) 求 $x$ 的值。(8分)
(b) 求 2020 年至 2023 年間的平均每年百分比變化。(5分)
solution_steps_en: (b) Let average annual change be $r$.$20%0,000$(1 + r)^3 = 14,580$.$
